items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Percy was about four... My father... got me, and Percy, Percy New Orleans. Stayed right out there.

ctx.x: Listen I wanted to ask you a few things, you know just uh, when were you born and where and that kind of stuff. That's okay. Yeah, when were you born exactly? 1902, September the 9th.
And where were you born? New Orleans, Louisiana, Jenna and Robinson. Near where Percy's home is now. That's right, right at the corner. You know they're parking lot of you? That's where it's born.
And I wanted you to tell me more about your uh, the way you grew up. Uh, did you, did you hear much music around the house when you were growing up?
